عبد الله بن كعب بن مالك

notes: Two routes to Ka'b's account of Tabuk meet at يونس and at the Companion, but the text writes the names in each branch, so both are written out in full (null tail); the first ends with a direct «سمعت كعب»; the second has عبد الله بن كعب as the one who heard him; the story's «ح» is a branch break, not a second saying
